name: Triple confluence, meta-labeled: fear + VIX + funding flush, sized by a learned win-probability
rationale: Thesis: the cross-market stress triple (fear_greed extreme-low + vix_level elevated + funding_rate flushed) is the PRIMARY signal; a secondary triple-barrier meta-label (Lopez de Prado) reads funding_rate, vix_level and rsi point-in-time at entry and predicts P(this trade is a net winner after costs), SKIPPING low-probability fires. The bet is that the triple is directionally right but its hit-rate varies with conditions the level-thresholds can't capture, and a learned gate should lift net Sharpe by cutting the worst entries. Meta-label only sizes/skips, never flips direction, trains expanding-window PIT (no look-ahead). Long-only spot. Disconfirmer: must beat the SAME bare triple WITHOUT meta_label on deflated Sharpe after fees. If the bare primary matches, the classifier adds nothing but overfit on thin spot history and should be dropped. Honest FAIL valid.
catalyst: cross-market stress triple, gated by a learned win-probability
